chief_complaint: Elevated blood pressure and iron‑deficiency anemia identified on recent assessments
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 48‑year‑old woman with a history of stage 2 hypertension (SBP 146 mm Hg, DBP 82 mm Hg) and chronic iron‑deficiency anemia despite iron supplementation. Over the past decade she has developed prediabetes (A1c 5.9%) and reports ongoing stress, social isolation, and limited social contact. Dental evaluation revealed impacted molars. She uses a combined estrogen‑progestin vaginal contraceptive (NuvaRing) and works full‑time. No antihypertensive, glucose‑lowering, or lipid‑lowering therapies are documented. The last recorded encounter was in November 2019, and several key laboratory values (BMI, eGFR, lipid panel) are missing.
past_medical_history: Resolved conditions include gingivitis (resolved 2018-05-03), viral sinusitis (resolved 2017-01-21), a normal pregnancy (resolved 2016-09-15), and part‑time employment (resolved 2016-04-14).
social_determinants: Full‑time employment; limited social contact and social isolation documented for many years; education to high‑school level; no documented housing or financial instability but limited support network may affect health maintenance.
risk_factor_summary: Blood pressure: 146/82 mm Hg (stage 2 hypertension). Glycemic control: prediabetic (A1c 5.9%). Anemia present (flagged). Charlson comorbidity index 1; clinical complexity moderate; polypharmacy risk low (2 meds). Missing data: BMI, eGFR, total cholesterol, LDL. No antihypertensive, glucose‑lowering, or lipid‑lowering therapy despite elevated risk.

clinical_impression: Middle‑aged woman with uncontrolled stage 2 hypertension, persistent iron‑deficiency anemia, and prediabetes, compounded by chronic psychosocial stressors and dental pathology. She is on estrogen‑containing contraception, which may exacerbate blood pressure elevation. Management gaps include lack of antihypertensive therapy and missing metabolic/laboratory monitoring.
